extracted.intended_audience: patent office staff, IP professionals, TISC operators, and regional government/administration stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Annual-report style guidance and operational standards describing Rospatent's activities, international obligations, cooperation with WIPO and regional partners, TISC network management, Receiving Office/ISA/IPEA functions, and related services and metrics for 2019.

rubrics_metrics.name: TISC establishment agreements by level
rubrics_metrics.description: Organization of TISCs (Technology and Innovation Support Centers) through cooperation agreements that include basic provisions for TISCs of the 1st level, and trilateral agreements for TISCs of the 2nd and 3rd levels with FIPS and participating centers as parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019: 17 cooperation agreements (including basic provisions for 1st level) were concluded (11 renegotiated); 4 trilateral agreements for 2nd level (2 renegotiated); 1 trilateral agreement for 3rd level. Agreements define roles/parties and form the legal basis for TISC operation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of free access to FIPS databases for TISCs
rubrics_metrics.description: TISCs must be granted free access to FIPS databases to support their activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access to FIPS databases is provided to enable TISCs to inform and assist applicants and users; this is part of TISC support arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online filing and digital signature support for TISCs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision of an online filing opportunity for TISC applications for IP objects and facilitation of obtaining digital signature key certificates for applicants via agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019, 15 additional agreements were signed to enable online filing and issuance of digital signature verification key certificates; 36 digital signature verification keys were issued under the TISC contracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: TISC network planning (Development Concept 2019–2024)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopt and follow a multi-year TISC development concept guiding network growth and activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The draft TISC Development Concept for 2019–2024 was adopted; such a concept frames priorities and planned measures for TISC support and scaling.

rubrics_metrics.name: TISC performance monitoring and rating
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor regional TISCs and form ratings on TISC efficiency by overall, by federal district, by level (1st/2nd), and by types of hosts (universities, libraries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A 'TISC Map' and monitoring data were used to form general and specialized ratings; 15 best TISCs were identified based on this monitoring. Metrics and methodology are implied though not exhaustively detailed in the report.

rubrics_metrics.name: TISC training, congress and outreach participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Organize and evaluate TISC engagement through congresses, seminars, exhibitions, and training sessions as part of network development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019 the VII Congress of TISCs was held with 93 TISCs participating; special events such as WIPO training seminars and public lectures were organized. Participation in such events is a performance indicator for TISCs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and dissemination of TISC best practices and brochures
rubrics_metrics.description: Publish informational materials and best-practice guides to support TISC activities and raise awareness among stakeholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brochures such as 'Best Practices of the Technology and Innovation Support Centers' (top 15 TISCs) and informational brochures for offices/individuals were issued to promote TISC activities and share successful models.

rubrics_metrics.name: TISCs must report project activities for public publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Regional TISCs should provide details on their project activities (youth initiatives, business initiatives, educational projects) for publication on the FIPS website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accumulated TISC data on project activities are published on the TISC page of the FIPS website to increase transparency and knowledge sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: TISC staff certification proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop a certification system for TISC staff to assess service-delivery skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals were made to create certification for TISC staff; details on competencies and assessment methods are to be developed as part of collaboration with WIPO and the TISC network.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of an online platform for TISC data exchange
rubrics_metrics.description: Create an online service platform to exchange information regarding effective data collection, analysis, and management within the TISC network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform should support shared best practices, data-driven monitoring, and management; necessary details were provided during cooperation with WIPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of documentation and informational resources to TISCs
rubrics_metrics.description: Supply sets of patent documentation and information products (guides, catalogs, internet navigators, recommended bibliographies) to TISCs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019 sets of Russian patent documentation (917 DVD-ROMs) and materials prepared by the VPTB Division were distributed and published on the FIPS website to support TISC services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of conferences and thematic meetings for IP outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Host thematic meetings, seminars and round tables to address IP challenges and engage TISCs and stakeholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent hosted 29 thematic meetings; 11 TISCs organized events with 2,428 participants (527 via videoconference). Such events serve as outreach and capacity-building measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure coefficient of inventive activity (Kia) as a regional KPI
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the coefficient of inventive activity (Kia), with and without utility models, to analyze regional inventive performance and identify leading regions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Kia in 2019: 1.59 (excluding UMs) and 2.25 (including UMs). Regions with maximum Kia were identified and used for regional analysis and policy focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation of tripartite agreements for regional IP management
rubrics_metrics.description: Use trilateral agreements between the Ministry of Economic Development, Rospatent, and regional authorities to implement recommendations on managing rights to results of intellectual activity and means of individualization in regions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject of such agreements: interaction in introduction of recommendations into practical activities and assistance in IP development; agreements were concluded with several regions in 2019.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling citizen and legal entity requests (service metrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Record and analyze the number and nature of requests received by Rospatent and subordinate bodies, including channels (email, website, phone) and composition (citizens vs legal entities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019, 1,911 requests considered (1,489 citizens, 422 legal entities); 841 received via e-mail/website; citizens constitute 78% of requests. Monitor increases year-over-year and geography of requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of requests (applications, complaints, proposals) and complaint rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Classify received requests by type and track justified complaint rates per ten thousand applications across patent law objects, means of individualization, and state registration of programs/databases/TICs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019: 88% applications, 11% complaints, 1% proposals. Justified complaint rates: patent law objects—1.5 per 10k applications; means of individualization—1.4; state registration of programs/databases/TICs—1.9. Take corrective measures when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of free CRS consultations and service scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide free consultations (CRS) on general IP issues that do not require systematic legal analysis, via phone, e-mail, and oral consultations, covering preparation, filing, examination, and validity of protection titles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019 CRS received 79,219 requests covering 127,465 questions (phone, email, oral). Around half of the consultation questions concern trademarks. Track volume and growth of consultation channels as service KPIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotion of national language and translations in WIPO publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Support inclusion of financing to expand WIPO official publications translated into Russian to broaden access to substantive IP materials in the national language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On Rospatent's proposal, additional financing was included in WIPO Program/Budget 2020–2021 to expand Russian-language materials and analytical/reference documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development of WIPO standards for 3D models and images
rubrics_metrics.description: Lead and participate in a Task Force to define tasks, goals, formats, technical means, best practices, and legal framework for using 3D models and images in applications and publication documents, culminating in a WIPO Standard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work includes research on industrial use, stakeholder consultations (including service users), drafting recommendations for industrial standardization of 3D models/images, and preparing a WIPO Standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development of WIPO guidance on Blockchain for IP offices
rubrics_metrics.description: Co-lead a Blockchain Task Force to analyze office experience and industrial use cases and prepare recommendations/guidelines for using Blockchain technology in IP protection and information processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Task Force analyzes opportunities for Blockchain in IP processing, prepares draft recommendations and guidelines for presentation to the Committee on WIPO Standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and knowledge exchange on AI and examination practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Initiate research and meetings to exchange experience on the use of AI in examination and on patentability assessment of inventions in IT and AI fields; study time of consideration of patent applications in national offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent proposed research on application consideration time and organized meetings/sessions on AI use and patentability in IT/AI. These inform potential procedural and policy changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis of IP and development in a digital environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct comprehensive analysis of gaps and opportunities to bridge the digital divide and expand access to ICTs as they relate to IP, enabling member states to present national/regional projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Following a CDIP thematic session, WIPO will analyze existing gaps/opportunities; results aim to guide member states' projects for digital IP development and inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthening protection for stage directors (SCCR initiative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop an initiative to consolidate the legal status and protection of theater stage directors via amendment of international agreements or new instruments, based on comparative case studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent advanced the initiative at SCCR; a case study on national legislation and enforcement is underway and results to be presented to SCCR in 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-related quality, timeliness, and process optimization standards
rubrics_metrics.description: As ISA/IPEA and participant in PCT bodies, ensure timely, high-quality international search and preliminary examination reports, manage relationships between international and national phases, maintain PCT Minimum Documentation, develop online services, and optimize PCT fee transfer processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent participates in Meetings of International Authorities and a Subgroup on Quality; focal points include report quality/timeliness, online service development, and fee-transfer optimization. Also promoted reduced PCT fees for universities from developing countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receiving Office filing requirements (PCT Article 10, Rule 19)
rubrics_metrics.description: Receiving Offices accept international applications from nationals or residents of the State and must accept applications in permitted languages per PCT rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent, as Receiving Office, accepts international applications from nationals/residents and accepts Russian and English-language filings. This is done under PCT Article 10 and Rule 19.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rospatent roles as ISA/IPEA and use of bilateral agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform international search and preliminary examination in Russian and English for Russian and foreign applicants as an ISA/IPEA under agreement with IB WIPO and via bilateral agreements with organizations (EAPO, Turkpatent, CIS offices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agreement covers 01.01.2018–31.12.2027; in 2019 Rospatent received 3,939 international search requests and prepared reports under bilateral agreements for Eurasian, Turkish and CIS applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: E-filing adoption and metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide electronic filing channels (e.g., WIPO ePCT and national e-filing services), monitor uptake and report proportions of online filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Since 1 Jan 2016 Rospatent accepted e-filings via WIPO ePCT; in 2019, 264 applications (20.15% of total) were filed online (up from 15.9% in 2018). For Hague industrial design international filings, a Russian-interface e-filing ('My Account') was launched in January 2019.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role under the Eurasian Patent Convention (RO for Eurasian applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Act as Receiving Office for Russian applicants filing Eurasian applications in accordance with Article 15(1)(ii) of the Eurasian Patent Convention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019, 152 Eurasian applications were submitted to Rospatent; the office handles the acceptance and forwarding per the Convention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Madrid System issues: harmonization and procedural timelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Engage in Working Group discussions on replacing national/regional registration with international registration, response periods to provisional refusal notices, and reduction of dependency periods of international registrations on the basic mark.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent participated in the 17th Working Group session addressing these Madrid System challenges to streamline international trademark registration procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hague System e-filing and service improvements for industrial designs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide national e-filing services (with national-language interface) for international registration of industrial designs to reduce processing time and costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In January 2019, FIPS launched an e-filing service with a Russian interface via 'My Account' that reduces time and forwarding costs compared to paper filing; this supported a 275% increase in applications filed with Rospatent for international registration of industrial designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Active participation in IPC, Locarno and Nice classification bodies and updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Contribute corrections, proposals, translations and publish national machine-readable versions for international classification systems (IPC, Locarno, NCL/NICE).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019 Rospatent submitted 1,781 IPC corrections included in IPC-2020.01 (Russian machine-readable), submitted 6 proposals to Locarno (accepted), and contributed to NCL updates culminating in NCL 11–2020 with an official Russian version published on the FIPS website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Questionnaire-based evidence gathering for standards development (3D use)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft and circulate questionnaires among industrial property offices to gather data on 3D use as input for drafting recommendations and WIPO Standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent led drafting of a questionnaire on 3D use; planned analysis of results will inform draft recommendations to be presented to the Committee on WIPO Standards.
